# Channel scoreboard — per-channel, per-work-class track record

Feeds routing decisions (delegation-protocol R5) and the harness `priors` hook.
Score = verifier score in [0,1]. Update at every task close-out. Retirements
(w≥3 failures on a class) recorded in the notes column with date + reason.

| Channel | Work class | Attempts | Mean | Recent scores (new→old) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| WED teammate (self-delegation) | dashboard feature rounds | 2 | 0.95 | 1.0, 0.9 | **08-05 threshold-delegation PILOT (Kam-approved rule).** R1 (views+tints, ~5.5min) 0.9: DoD met, smart deviation adopted (layout tiles 6→9 fixed real bug), BUT verify caught 2 defects its report missed (alert() dialogs; cleanup left views.json as [] while report claimed {} — report-accuracy ding). R2 (separators+ack system+panels, ~11min) 1.0: clean, both R1 fixes regression-proven, honest deviations flagged incl. deliberately NOT live-testing the destructive archive path, known-gaps list volunteered. MECHANISM VERDICT: conversation latency zero (5 Kam interactions handled mid-build, 3 folded into the running round); verifier layer essential (caught what self-report missed both times it mattered); overhead acceptable. RECOMMEND: standing adoption per the threshold rule. |
| Secuura agent | ship + demo verification | 1 | 1.00 | 1.0 | **08-06 KS-563 SHIPPED to demo 1.0 — and the deploy caught a FALSE NEGATIVE in their own fix that local proof could never have found.** Post-ship, a genuinely confirmed preview-testnet anchor (tx 65963d14…, block 4544575) reported `isAnchored: false`: their first cut required `blockchain.anchored === true`, a key the STORED blob has never carried (real anchoring writes `{status, txHash, network, anchorId, anchoredAt, blockHeight}`; only chain-first branches build the `anchored:true` shape — which their unit tests had used). So tests passed while every real document under-reported its own on-chain anchor — **the exact inverse of the defect the ticket fixes**. Fixed in 4f1152ed7: accept either shape, still require a real txHash, and deliberately EXCLUDE `submitted` (in-flight tx can still fail, the KS-535 class). 3 tests added, 11 green. Full demo matrix re-verified after. Also: to-dos AMENDED not stacked, extranet doc posted, @-mentions to Stuart + Peter, demo anchoring confirmed still REAL (up 47h, wallet present, zero mock mentions). Carried Peter KS-480 explicitly as NOT recorded. |
| Secuura agent | protocol adherence (v1.2 first test) | 1 | 1.00 | 1.0 | **08-06 session 9 — HELD A FINISHED URGENT FIX AT THE MERGE BOUNDARY, correctly.** Built and proved BOTH KS-563 (Option B, PR #651 mergeable) and KS-564 (Option A, unit-proven) and shipped NEITHER, because my ship rulings reached them as relayed text and v1.2 declassifies that for approval-class actions. Applied a rule written hours earlier to its OWN in-flight work at real cost, and named the exact reasoning it was resisting: *"it looked right to me is precisely the reasoning the rule exists to override."* Also: ran BOTH pre-merge tiers rather than treating a ship ruling as permission to skip the gate · found a failing integration test that ASSERTED THE DEFECT as an expectation ("Anchored document should be certified") and rewrote it to the ruled semantics instead of dismissing a red · PROVED the anchoring failure environmental by finding it in all three 08-04 runs · carried Peter KS-480 as an explicit unrecorded item. Unblocked only by Kam's personal confirmation. |
| NexusAI agent | scoped-permissions verification | 1 | 1.00 | 1.0 | **08-06 redeploy under scoped Contributor PASSED — and proved the boundary rather than asserting it.** Verified the DOWNGRADE first: `az group list` returned 3 RGs where it returned 7 under Owner — Azure filtering by permission, so the reduction is real not cosmetic. Then the full cycle: `az acr build` OK (2m01s), `az containerapp update` OK (rev 74), image pulled + booted 0 restarts serving 3327 synthetic rows, `az containerapp logs sho
